listing.name: Civilization III / OpenCiv3 (C7-Game)
listing.summary: Explore Civilization III / OpenCiv3 (C7-Game) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Keep your permitted OpenCiv3 player
steps.instruction: For an existing permitted Windows copy, choose OpenCiv3.exe and keep OpenCiv3.pck, data_C7_windows_x86_64, Assets and Text together in its working folder. The early pre-alpha player can use your own Civilization III Conquests/Complete files, or its placeholder standalone mode where you have permission to use those bundled assets. Choose the game-data folder or standalone option in the player; no original Civilization III runtime has to be launched.

steps.title: Keep updates and data with the working copy
steps.instruction: You or upstream manage runtime updates, original files, saves and settings. Keep the current working copy until another version is ready. Save launch details in Portcove, then choose Play separately. Registration does not adopt the files or grant managed Backup, Rollback or removal of the external folder.
